target_dedupe_method: Exact board/system names were compared against catalog project title/game/subtype strings and prior project-manifest title/game/target fields. Generic multi-system MAME or embedded game ports are recorded as related coverage, not as an exact board-core duplicate. Hardware revisions such as Sega System 1 versus System 16B remain distinct.
